final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor provided no new admissible evidence and identified no new evidence IDs; the response mainly reframed the same record into a narrower, caveated certification theory. That narrowing is analytically better than a clean compliance claim, but it is still not enough for compliant_with_caveats here because the caveat is itself an unresolved policy predicate: the record still does not show either approved risk acceptance covering aviation maintenance triage or completed pre-launch disclosure of that material limitation. Under the policy text, rollout controls are supplemental only and do not remove disclosure duties while the affected use case remains exposed. On the available evidence summary alone, the position remains plausible but not proven compliant.
